title: Data Types, Operators, and Strings
learning_outcomes: Explain the role of data types, operators, and strings in Swift development.
Apply the module concepts in a small, inspectable Swift example.
Verify examples with a suitable local toolchain or a documented human review.

overview_visual.alt_text: Module 3: Data Types, Operators, and Strings. Lessons in order: Introduction to Swift Data Types; Integer Types; Floating-Point Types; Boolean Type; Character and String Types; Type Conversion and Initialization; Arithmetic Operators; Comparison and Logical Operators; Assignment and Compound Assignment; Operator Precedence and Custom Operators.
